sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel away to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain strong leaders and will be heavy favourites against bottom-of-the-table Alsager, who have won just once all season and are on a lengthy run without victory.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from their own recent loss and close the two-point gap at the top. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, face Eccleshall at home in what should be a competitive mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, travel to Wednesfield Community, who have shown recent improvement with consecutive wins. Bilston Town—fifth and in-form—host Foley Meir, while Barnton entertain Shawbury United in a fixture between mid-table and bottom-dwelling sides; Shawbury are in dire form with six consecutive defeats. Brereton Social (joint 14th) start at home to Widnes Town, who occupy last place with just 2 points and a goal difference of -23. Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a battle between two struggling sides near the bottom half. Crewe host Allscott Heath, and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in fixtures involving lower-table teams. A Wednesday night follow-up sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community on 7 October at 19:45.
